name: xyz.arc-hive/archive
title: ArcHive
description: Pay-per-use USDC marketplace of Intel TDX enclaves verified on Arc testnet: read, check, prepare

tools.name: arc_products
tools.description: Lists the products of Arc's enclave network (price with its unit, shares, settlement, minimum bond, state). Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).

tools.name: arc_enclaves
tools.description: Lists the enclaves (the hive): operator, product, TCB, active or not at the head block, validity window in blocks, registered X25519 key. Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).

tools.name: arc_bounties
tools.description: Lists the sealed bounties of BOTH levels (open: SealedBounty; verified: SealedBountyVerified, where only enclaves on a chip declared by a Proof of Cloud auditor count) and the products each level settles: level, contract, protocol, product, balance, deadline, pause, open or not. Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).

tools.name: arc_sessions
tools.description: Lists the SessionPay sessions opened by an account: product, deposit, already settled, remainder, closed, expiry. Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).

tools.name: arc_activity
tools.description: Recent on-chain activity of the network's contracts (enclave registrations, sessions, settlements, bounties, verdicts), newest first. Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).

tools.name: arc_pricing
tools.description: Cost of a use: units × the product's price, with a readable line giving the unit (per token for a prepaid session, per call for x402, free, or paid by a bounty's pool).

tools.name: arc_verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks an inference receipt the way SessionPay.settle does: the session's locked enclave, active at the anchor block under its operator, locked model, growing cumulative total; and what the settlement would pay.

receipt.description: the receipt signed by the enclave, as it returns it (fields as decimal and hex strings)

signature.description: the enclave's EIP-712 signature: 0x + 130 hex (65 bytes)

tools.name: arc_enclave_status
tools.description: State of ONE enclave by its signer: operator, product, TCB, expiry, active or not, the operator's bond (total, available, 24 h exposure on this product).

tools.name: arc_session_status
tools.description: State of a SessionPay session: owner, product, operator, deposit, already paid, remainder, expiry, closed.

tools.name: arc_bounty_prepare_create
tools.description: Creates a sealed bounty, with a predicate helper ("the USDC balance of the target contract drops by at least minDrop" → ERC20_DROP clause), tiers, fees read on-chain, createBounty parameters and an EIP-3009 authorization. PREPARES only: signs and sends nothing, returns the data the user signs in their wallet.

from.description: the protocol's wallet, which funds and signs

minDrop.description: minimum drop that proves the exploit, in USDC

reward.description: the hunter's reward in USDC (one tier)

tiers.description: several tiers [{ minLoss, amount }] in USDC

funding.description: initial funding in USDC (default: one payment of the highest tier, fees included)

protocolX25519.description: the protocol's PUBLIC X25519 key (never the private one)

productId.description: the Sealed Bounty product (default: the open level's); arc_bounties names the products of each level

tools.name: arc_operator_plan
tools.description: Step-by-step plan to become an operator: Intel TDX VM (Phala), app-compose, /attest, bond, registerEnclave, renewal; the bond rules with the figures read on-chain.

tools.name: arc_operator_prepare_bond
tools.description: Operator bond deposit: EIP-3009 authorization for bond(), or encoded approve + bondFrom; checks balance, ban and minimum bond. PREPARES only: signs and sends nothing, returns the data the user signs in their wallet.

tools.name: arc_operator_prepare_register
tools.description: Enclave registration: anchor block, reading the VM's /attest (if enclaveUrl and operator are given), encoded registerEnclave transaction. PREPARES only: signs and sends nothing, returns the data the user signs in their wallet.

tools.name: arc_product_scaffold
tools.description: Skeleton of a third-party product: container + enclave kit, app-compose, manifest, propose() parameters, then timelock and activate (bpsOperator + bpsAuthor + bpsNetwork = 10,000).

tools.name: arc_machines_list
tools.description: An operator's machines (nodes) from the ArcHive API: mode (tdx, dstack, demo), online, last heartbeat, product, enclave URL and signer, diagnostics OK, registered. Read only.

tools.name: arc_machine_diagnostics
tools.description: Diagnostics of an operator's machine (ArcHive API): failed checks with the fix to apply, normal failures for the mode, recent log, attestation, on-chain registration. Read only.
